subject: Vinicius Junior scores a 21-minute hat-trick as Brazil beat Singapore 7-0
title: Three goals in 21 minutes, still not happy

lines.vo: Three goals in twenty-one minutes, and he still looked upset.
lines.footage: Vinicius Junior hat-trick Singapore, goal montage

lines.vo: Vinicius Junior has one Real Madrid goal in twelve games this season.
Then Singapore: his first international hat-trick, in a seven-nil win.
Singapore are ranked one hundred and forty-eighth, and even helped with an own goal. Generous hosts.
Vinicius was substituted early in the second half, and looked far from happy. Greedy, or just hungry?
lines.footage: Vinicius substituted, Brazil Singapore second half; reaction close-up

lines.vo: Twelve games, one goal. Twenty-one minutes, three. Maybe it is the Singapore air.
